name: Trustgrid MCP
description:
The Trustgrid MCP server exposes tools that enable troubleshooting and reporting workflows for agents. 

If a device is offline or a connection is slow or you want to know who your top talkers are, your agent can easily answer all of your questions with MCP access to your Trustgrid account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trustgrid MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trustgrid MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.devs.dev.trustgrid.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trustgrid MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trustgrid MCP provides these MCP tools: code, describe, followUp, get_context, glossary, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trustgrid MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Trustgrid MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Trustgrid MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trustgrid MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Trustgrid MCP is developed by Trustgrid. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
